settings.editor: Our parent company, Top Notch Logworks, builds log and timber homes. We understand construction schedules, and we finish new work the way it should be finished.

settings.title: A finishing partner who speaks your language

settings.editor:
We work in partnership with architects, builders and general contractors on new homes and remodels. Painting, staining, preservative treatment and chinking on new log and timber work is exactly what our team does every day.

You get a clear written bid, a crew that shows up when scheduled, and one point of contact who coordinates with your superintendent.

• Interior and exterior painting on new construction
  • Log and timber staining and preservatives
  • Chinking and sealing on new log homes
  • Specialty finishes and interior wood
  • Work sequenced around other trades

settings.title: “They have performed in an expedient manner and have produced an exceptional product at a fair price.”
David M., project manager · Aspen Construction

settings.editor: Send us the basics and we'll be in touch within one business day. Plans, specs and finish schedules help us price accurately.
